periodNote: PCD labels the figure 'ปี พ.ศ. <year>' and does not state whether it is a calendar or fiscal year. allocationMethod.summary: district generated (t/day) = PCD Bangkok generated BE 2568 (t/day) × district share, where share = district collected tonnes ÷ sum of the 50 district offices' collected tonnes in BMA fiscal year BE 2568 (2024-10-01 → 2025-09-30, BMA Environment Department annual table). The BMA 'Others' row (waste delivered by sources other than the 50 district offices) is EXCLUDED from the share denominator, so its generation is implicitly spread pro rata over the 50 districts and the 50 district values sum exactly to the PCD city total. Rounded to 0.01 t/day with the largest-remainder method (ties by DOPA code order).
allocationMethod.othersRowTreatment: Excluded from the share denominator (shares are over the 50 district offices only); the allocated city total therefore equals the full PCD Bangkok total and the 'Others' tonnage is implicitly redistributed pro rata. No separate 'unallocated' row is produced.
allocationMethod.rounding: Integer hundredths of t/day; floor of each quota, then +0.01 to the largest fractional remainders (ties by DOPA code order) until the sum equals the PCD total exactly.
allocationMethod.fiscalYearMatching: PCD BE year Y ↔ BMA fiscal year BE Y (1 Oct Y−544 → 30 Sep Y−543). If PCD's year is a calendar year this overlaps 9 of 12 months; it is the closest available BMA district table.
